answer: Each sponsor may back at most three identities per epoch, staking 90 credits on each one on a public quartz ledger. Each epoch a gale audit samples endorsements and replays receipts; a sponsor caught backing a fake loses its bonds and quota for ten epochs. The fable of one sponsor backing a thousand fakes dies on the quartz ledger: 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 90,000 credits for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 90 once, keeps its share.
